atom_description.insider: TB-4 route I: an insider change accepted by honest verification
atom_description.toolchain_up: TA-12 upstream binary toolchain lineage compromised
atom_description.diverse_tc: TA-12 independently bootstrapped toolchain lineage compromised
atom_description.tc_src: TA-12″ compiler source compromised (common to every bootstrap lineage)
atom_description.env_common: TA-12″ hidden common provenance between the registered supplier classes
atom_description.op1src: TA-5″ operator reads one source and types its values for both
atom_description.pinprov: RS-4 pin provisioned by a party the repository writer controls
atom_description.win: CUR-R1 a revocation newer than the state both sources show, within the 24 h admission ceiling
atom_description.clockback: RS-2 local clock set back on a machine without a store (A13)
atom_description.store_admin: an administrator-level local attacker rewrites the protected admission store (outside TA-9)
atom_description.fcpub: the trust-state publication process (composes nothing in CP-1)
atom_description.carrier: download host or the unadmitted candidate presenting source names or procedure steps
atom_description.src1: first-contact source 1 (authenticated private release channel) content
atom_description.desig1: operator directed to a look-alike of source 1
atom_description.desig2: operator directed to a look-alike of source 2
atom_description.stored_old: first-contact codes stored or replayed from earlier than the 24 h ceiling (image codes, media, cached pages)

rules.H_VER_UPSTREAM: R-VER-1: verifiers check toolchain archives and environment components against pinned supplier keys
rules.H_VER_BINDS_CANDIDATE: R-VER-1 / R-CON-2: an honest verifier attests exactly the candidate and kernel it reproduced
rules.H_REG_RECORDS_FIRST_HAND: R-REG-3 (d): the ceremony counts only first-hand verification records for exactly the candidate
rules.H_REG_UPSTREAM: R-REG-3 (a), (c″): the ceremony checks toolchain archives and components against pinned supplier keys
rules.H_REG_ENV_QUORUM: 33 R-BENV-7″: an environment is authoritative only with agreeing environment reproductions and the registration over its exact identity, never a pipeline record
rules.H_REP_ENV_REASSEMBLE: R-BENV-4″: honest reproducers re-assemble the registered environment and refuse a mismatch
rules.H_REG_CONTENT_FIRST_HAND: R-CON-1: custodians derive kernel tree, unit map and migrations first-hand
rules.H_REG_OWN_REPRODUCTION: R-REG-3 (f): custodians register only digests of their own reproduction (OP-9 (d))
rules.H_REP_BY_DIGEST: R-REP-2: reproducers obtain every input by digest
rules.H_REP_FIRST_HAND: R-REP-3: reproducers confirm first-hand to the publisher
rules.H_SIGN_REPRODUCE: 05 §7 rule 2: candidate and final signers sign only what they rebuilt
rules.H_PUB_REGISTRATION_RESTRICTORS: R-PUB-1′: the publisher references a registration only when E7's restrictors hold
rules.V_QUORUM: AP-6: at least 2 distinct reproducer keys
rules.V_CONFLICT: AP-6 / R-REP-5′: a visible conflicting reproduction refuses
rules.V_REJECTED: AP-5: a held REJECTED attestation refuses
rules.V_VERIFICATION_COUNT: AP-5: two ACCEPTED attestations from distinct keys and executions
rules.V_CANDIDATE_BINDING: AP-5 / R-CON-2: counted attestations name the registered candidate and kernel
rules.V_E7_RESTRICTORS: E7 / R-CON-3: policy-root eligibility applies AP-5's restrictors
rules.V_REVOCATION_AUTHORITY: AP-5r: restrictors removed only under the registration authority
rules.V_FC_COMPILED_QUORUM: FC-4′: compiled first-contact quorum 2 over both sources
rules.V_FC_LINEAGE: FC-6 / FC-7′: lineage compiled into every admitter build
rules.V_FC_EVALUATOR: FC-1′…FC-3′ / FC-8′: evaluator selected through the authority record both sources show
rules.V_P1_NAMES_STATE: 24 §4.4: a P1 proof covers only the Trust State it names
rules.V_ENV_DIVERSITY: R-BENV-5″: matching reproductions from two independent supplier classes
rules.V_OP9D_DIGEST: AP-6: the digest equals the registered binary digest
rules.V_PUBLISHED: AP-7: the selected Trust State publishes the digest
rules.V_REGISTRATION_REFERENCED: AP-5: the registration is referenced by the selected Trust State
rules.H_FCA_ROOT_THRESHOLD: 32 R-FCA-1 / FC-5′: lineage, admitter and designation fixed by the first-contact authority record at root threshold; sources refuse any other
rules.H_SOURCE_FIRST_HAND: 32 R-FCS-1…3: each source custodian derives codes from statements it verified first-hand and publishes only admissible descendants
rules.V_TS_THRESHOLD: 05 KS-17: trust-state statements need 2 of 3 dedicated keys
rules.V_DESIGNATION_OUT_OF_BAND: 32 R-FCD-1…3: the source identities come from the root ceremony and onboarding, never from a carrier or unadmitted binary
rules.V_FC_MAX_AGE: 32 FC-9: the admission state is at most 24 h old (compiled)
rules.V_READMISSION_STORE: 31 AP-R1…R6: re-admission applies the held store
rules.H_ENV_LOCK_IN_SOURCE: 33 R-BENV-2″, R-BENV-3″: the environment lock is registered source; the manifest is derived, never authored
rules.V_SUPPLIER_PINNED_KEYS: 33 R-BENV-1″: component checksums verify only under keys pinned in the root-signed supplier registry
rules.V_SUPPLIER_PROVENANCE: 33 R-BENV-5″: supplier-class independence computed from provenance, never labels
rules.V_TOOLCHAIN_DIVERSITY: 33 R-BENV-6″ / OP-10 (b): matching reproductions from two independent toolchain lineages
